title: Not quite comfortable enough
text:
Not quite comfortable enough. JunHoter Bath Pillow is made of a nylon mesh material with a spongy cushion inside that allows water to pass through easily. It means that it can be submerged in water during a bath but will dry quickly after, especially if hung up by its included hook.

Compared to other bath pillows, the JunHoter Bath Pillow has less cushion. The side flaps don't provide much support and the top part sits near the base of the neck, which is not too bad.

It really isn't a bad pillow, but I was just expected to feel more comfortable than I did when I used it.
